verdict.rationale: Missive connects existing Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, and IMAP accounts, with full two-way sync for Gmail. Its address books sync with Office 365 and Google, so a switcher's mail and contacts come along through account sync. The evidence never says complete historical mail is pulled in, and it shows no import path from another client or from non-Google/Microsoft contact sources. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that full mail history imports, import from local clients or archive files (e.g. mbox), contact import beyond Office 365/Google sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
